items.name: Ash-Wood Hoplite Dory
items.description: An eight-foot ash shaft tipped with a leaf-shaped bronze spearhead and balanced by a four-sided bronze sauroter spike.

mythologicalLore.note: Ash from Mount Pelion was favored by heroic spear-makers; Chiron cut the great spear of Peleus from its slopes.

items.name: Bronze Xiphos
items.description: A double-edged, leaf-shaped bronze short sword suited for close-quarters fighting once the spear is spent.

mythologicalLore.note: The straight thrusting blade carried in a baldric across the chest.

items.name: Yew Hunting Bow
items.description: A curved wooden bow crafted from mountain yew, strung with twisted sinew.

mythologicalLore.note: Hunters of the Cithaeron forest dedicated their bows to Artemis Agrotera.

items.name: Argive Aspis Shield
items.description: A deep, bowl-shaped wooden shield faced with beaten bronze sheet. Fitted with a revolutionary central forearm porpax strap and antilabe handgrip.

mythologicalLore.note: The Carians invented shield grips and blazons, perfected by Argive armories.

items.name: Layered Linothorax
items.description: A body cuirass composed of laminated sheets of heavy linen glued into a stiff, resilient torso defense with shoulder flaps.

mythologicalLore.note: Ajax son of Oileus fought renowned in a linen corslet rather than heavy bronze.

items.name: Bronze Corinthian Helmet
items.description: Beaten from a single bronze ingot, covering the cheeks and nose with narrow eye slits. Intimidating and protective, though muffling distant sounds.

mythologicalLore.note: The iconic helmet worn by hoplites across the Aegean.

items.name: Woolen Traveler's Chlamys
items.description: A rectangular wool mantle pinned at the right shoulder with a bronze fibula, standard dress for messengers and hunters.

mythologicalLore.note: The cloak of Hermes and the Attic ephebes.

items.name: Aryballos of Pramnian Wine
items.description: A small globular terracotta vessel filled with fragrant, dark Pramnian wine suitable for restoring spirits or pouring a sacred libation to the gods.

mythologicalLore.note: Pramnian wine was renowned for its strength and used in heroic offerings.

items.name: Herbal Salve of Epidaurus
items.description: An unguent compounded from mountain thyme, beeswax, and crushed dittany from Crete, blessed in the tradition of Asclepius.

mythologicalLore.source: Virgil, Aeneid 12.412; Theophrastus, Enquiry into Plants
mythologicalLore.note: Cretan dittany was reputed to drive out spear-points and knit wounded flesh.

items.name: Dried Attic Figs & Barley Cakes
items.description: Sweet sun-dried figs and toasted barley cakes, the staples of marching warriors and herdsmen.

mythologicalLore.note: The nourishing bread of rural Attica and Boeotia.

items.name: Archaic Bronze Bell of Hermes
items.description: A small cast-bronze bell hung from the horn of Daidalos' prize sacrificial ram, incised with archaic dedication letters to Hermes Kriophoros.

mythologicalLore.note: Bells were dedicated in pastoral shrines to ward off malicious daimones and wolves.

items.name: Fragment of the Cadmean Stone
items.description: A slate fragment bearing ancient Phoenician-derived letters describing the sowing of the Dragon's teeth at Thebes.

mythologicalLore.note: Cadmus brought the art of letters (Phoinikeia grammata) to Boeotia.
